speaker: Skyler
teaser: Lost a fight with a handrail. Now one ear wears a beanie.
hello: Yo! Skyler Kickflip. Three months ago I tried to grind a handrail. The handrail won.
Smacked the left side of my head. Ever since, that ear sounds like it's wearing a beanie.

which_ear.say: The left, for sure. Right ear's perfect. Left's like listening through a beanie.
which_ear.note: Left ear muffled, right ear fine

say: All at once. I hit the ground, and the left ear went dull right then.
That was three months ago. Hasn't changed since. Not better, not worse.
onset.note: All at once, at the fall 3 months ago; steady

ringing.say: No ringing. It's just quiet on the left. Like someone turned the knob down.

say: No pain, no gunk, never dizzy. Not even after the slam.
It bled the day I fell, though. Loads. Nothing since.
red_flags.note: Bled at the fall; no pain, gunk or dizziness now

noise.say: Skate park wheels on concrete. Punk shows, but I wear earplugs. My mum's a nurse.

say: Never had an ear infection. Then the handrail.
Big bump on the left side of my head, blood out of my ear. Very bad day.
ear_history.note: Hit left side of head 3 months ago; ear bled

family.say: Nope. Whole family hears fine. Especially my little sister. She hears EVERYTHING.
family.note: No hearing loss in the family

health.say: Healthy. A doctor checked my head bump that day and said I'd live. Nobody looked at the ear.
health.note: Doctor checked the head bump, not the ear

aids.say: Hearing aids? I'm nineteen! ...Wait. Is that a thing at nineteen?

say: Lectures. If the prof's on my left, I'm toast.
And at the park my mates shout tricks at me. From the left, I miss the lot.
hardest.note: Misses talk from the left side

right.caption: Skyler's RIGHT ear: a clean canal and a shiny, pearly eardrum. All good.

left.caption: Skyler's LEFT ear: a clean canal and a closed eardrum, all healed up. No hole, no blood.

otoscopy.note: Canals clear; left eardrum healed and closed

tymp.note: Tymp: right type A, left type Ad (a very tall peak)

decision_lines.fit: Not yet! A big gap after a knock needs a doctor first. It might be fixable.
decision_lines.refer: Refer! A big gap after a knock points to the hearing chain. A doctor decides; often it's fixable.
decision_lines.today: It came on suddenly, but three months ago, with a middle-ear gap. A doctor soon, not today.
decision_lines.clear: No aids needed? The left ear sits near 50 dB. That gap needs a doctor.

why.prompt: Why does Skyler see a doctor before anything else?
options: A big air-bone gap in the left ear since the fall.
Yes! Bone is fine, air isn't. A gap after a knock is the doctor's call, and often fixable.
Hearing aids can't help a conductive loss.
They can, and nicely! But a gap that might be fixed goes to a doctor first.
The left eardrum still has a hole in it.
The otoscope showed it healed shut. A hole reads flat on the tymp, with a big canal volume.
A type Ad tymp always means an operation.
Not always! A thin healed scar can be floppy too. Here it's floppy PLUS a big gap.

debrief: Healed eardrum, floppy peak, big gap after a knock: that points to the hearing chain behind it.
The hearing chain: three tiny bones behind the eardrum. Masked bone was normal, so the inner ear's fine.
Often fixable, but the doctor decides. Red flags: blood, sudden change, one ear worse, that gap.
goodbye: A letter for the ear doctor, with your chart. That gap may well be fixable.
Fixable? Like new bearings for my ear? Sick!
Till then, point your good right ear at the talker. Front row, prof on your right.
And a helmet. Every ride. Even the little ones.
Helmet, every ride. My mum's gonna frame that letter. Later, Hoot!

headlines.S: HANDRAIL 1, EAR 0: OWL CALLS FOR A REMATCH
headlines.A: SKATER'S GAP SPOTTED; HELMET SALES OLLIE UP
headlines.B: SKATER REFERRED, BUT A FEW STAMPS BAILED
headlines.C: CLINIC WIPES OUT ON SKATER'S CHART
headlines.Do-over: HANDRAIL WINS AGAIN; SKYLER BACK FOR A RE-RUN

subheads.S: A big air-bone gap after a knock, masked and measured. A doctor checks the hearing chain.
subheads.A: Bone normal, air down near 50: that gap goes to a doctor, and may be fixable.
subheads.B: The gap showed up, a few steps slipped. Mask the bone to prove a gap is real.
subheads.C: After a knock to the head: look, run the tymp, test bone, and count the red flags.
subheads.Do-over: Skyler will be back. So, sadly, will the handrail.
